title: A Deadline Moved Up
transcript:
Woman: Did you see Karen's email? The report's due Wednesday now, not Friday.
Man: You're kidding. I haven't even started the budget section.
Woman: I can take the charts off your plate if that helps. I've done them before.
Man: Really? That'd save me a whole day.
Woman: No problem. Just send me the spreadsheet by lunch.
Man: I'll send it in a few minutes. I owe you one.

questions.stem: Why does the woman say, "I can take the charts off your plate"?
options: To ask the man to make the charts
To suggest removing the charts from the report
To offer to do part of the man's work
To complain about having too much work
questions.explanation: "Take something off your plate" means to take over a task for someone.

questions.stem: What will the man probably do next?
options: Go to lunch with the woman
questions.explanation: The woman asks for the spreadsheet, and he says, "I'll send it in a few minutes."
